title: 长端债券收益率“滴水式”上行，债务动态成关键变量
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Stephen Major of Tradition to Bywriting Central Banks can initiate rate-hiking cycles to tame inflation, but underlying debt dynamics ultimately dictate how those cycles end.
segments.zh: 斯蒂芬·梅杰表示，央行可以启动加息周期来抑制通胀，但潜在的债务动态最终决定了这些周期的结局。

segments.en: Stephen joins us now for more. Steve, my friend, it's good to hear from you. It's good to see you.
segments.zh: 斯蒂芬现在加入我们。史蒂夫，我的朋友，很高兴听到你的消息。很高兴见到你。

segments.en: Hi, John. Are we on the blanket subon market pushback, limiting the ability to high rates here as some of these central banks?
segments.zh: 嗨，约翰。我们是否在讨论市场对央行加息能力的抵制，限制了这些央行提高利率的能力？

segments.en: Well, the focus is Jackson Hole already. I know it's a week or so away, but people are now discussing what's going to come up at these meetings,
segments.zh: 嗯，焦点已经是杰克逊霍尔了。我知道还有一周左右，但人们现在已经在讨论这些会议上会出现什么。

segments.en: because it's very often the case that big set piece moves happen at these conferences.
segments.zh: 因为大型政策变动往往在这些会议上发生。

segments.en: I think that you've reported the impact of debt and fiscal dynamics on bond yields and and earnings, and I think that you're quite right. It's a bit more complicated than just the debt
segments.zh: 我认为你报道了债务和财政动态对债券收益率和盈利的影响，我认为你说得很对。这比单纯的债务水平或财政状况要复杂一些。

segments.en: levels or the fiscal position, because when earnings are so strong, then the risk premium that goes on to the bond yields or the term premium has to be higher. I mean, try explaining to a young person
segments.zh: 因为当盈利如此强劲时，债券收益率或期限溢价上的风险溢价必须更高。我的意思是，试着向年轻人解释为什么他们应该购买债券，而权益资产每周都在创新高。

segments.en: why they should buy bonds when equities keep blowing the lights out every week.
segments.zh: 所以很简单。存在风险溢价，我认为财政动态有些令人担忧。

segments.en: So it's quite simple. There's the risk premium and I think the fiscal dynamics are somewhat worrying.
segments.zh: 我想你可以说，国际效应也会影响长期债券曲线，比如目前的日本国债，但几周前可能是英国国债或澳大利亚国债。

segments.en: I guess you could say there's an international effect as well on the long end of bond curves here in the JGBs at the moment, but a few weeks ago it might have been guilt or burns or Australia or something.
segments.zh: 可以说，目前日本长期国债收益率也受到国际因素影响，但几周前可能是其他市场的影响。
